newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait share index recovers some lost ground.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait share index recovers some lost ground.

text.p: The Kuwait stock index recovered some lost ground in the week to Wednesday, rising 14.4 points to 1,887.4, the Kuwait Stock Exchange said on Thursday.
Trading volume and value dropped this week compared to the previous one which was dominated by correction fears, pushing the index down 46.9 points to 1,873.
Trading value during the five-day week dropped to 129 million dinars ($431 million) from last week's 140.4 million dinars. Volume fell to 333.3 million shares from 478.4 million.
The price of 14 concerns were unchanged from the previous week while gainers led losers 21-15.
The largest price drop was recorded by Gulf Insurance Co which fell 40 fils to 0.590 dinars while Mobile Telecommunications Co made the biggest gain, rising 140 fils to 1.260 dinars.
There are 1,000 fils to the dinar.
By sector, services led trading by value accounting for 36.8 percent followed by banking and industrials respectively.
Banking was the most active by volume with 23.4 percent, investments came second followed by services shares.
Only nationals of Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Oman and Kuwait -- can trade on the exchange. Foreign residents can invest through mutual funds.
